title: Categorical contractibility of the finite inverse gadget
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices, coherent functor categories and coherent functor equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in universes enlarged as necessary. Let $Q$ be the degreewise pushout $$Q=\Delta^3\amalg_{\Delta^{\{0,2\}}\amalg\Delta^{\{1,3\}}}(\Delta^0\amalg\Delta^0),$$ where the edge with vertices $0,2$ is collapsed to the first point and the edge with vertices $1,3$ to the second point. For every quasicategory $E$, restriction along the unique map $p:Q\to\Delta^0$ gives a coherent functor equivalence $$p^*:E=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^0,E)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(Q,E).$$ No quasicategory or Kan condition is imposed on $Q$, and $E$ may be empty.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.2.7 (05ZJ): Q to the point is a categorical equivalence, in the whole-functor-category formulation of categorical equivalence. Kerodon identifiers, not Stacks tags; no Stacks tag states this higher categorical assertion. Read online 2026-10-17; archive WANTED.
